message.subject: Collaboration idea with EDXSO
message.email_body: Mastering the complexities of mobile hardware and camera technology is difficult for creators seeking clear technical insights. Your video on Apple Explains the iPhone Duo & 18 Pro Camera caught our attention. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes, leadership and sustainable institutional growth. We are exploring an exploratory UGC-style tutorial on practical technology workflows for educators, with format and terms open for discussion. This gives your audience a practical resource on modern tools. Please reply if a short call this month would suit them.
